messages:
Maria Chen: Quick check — were about to expose svc-ingest via a VPCE/PrivateLink in prod. Need a short boundary checklist: IP allowlist for partner access, inbound/outbound SG/NACL constraints, and confirmation that logs are redacted for PII before leaving the VPC. Can someone run this? cc @Jamal Ortiz @Olivia Park

Jamal Ortiz: I can take the network side. Which VPC/subnets + SGs are we using and who owns the partner CIDR? Also are logs going to S3 or Kinesis?

Maria Chen: VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d, private subnets priv-3a/priv-3b, sg-logging-ingest (sg-89ab). Partner has a static CIDR 203.0.113.0/28 but they'd prefer AWS principals if possible. Logs currently ship to s3://redwood-logs-prod via our log-forwarder role.

Olivia Park: If partner can use an AWS principal + VPCE endpoint policy that's ideal. No public IPs. If they must use on-prem CIDR, then limit to their /28 and document rotation steps.

Jamal Ortiz: For VPCE: create the interface endpoint in our VPC and set an endpoint policy restricting principals to partner account or specific role ARNs. Security group on the endpoint: allow inbound TCP 443 from partner ENIs or CIDR. Egress on the endpoints SG should only allow traffic to our logging stack and internal services (avoid 0.0.0.0/0). Consider an explicit deny via NACL if needed.

sec-sre-bot: Quick redaction note — ensure fluentd filter stage removes emails/SSNs/credit card patterns and strips Authorization headers. Example logstash/fluentd gsub snippet:

filter {
  if [log_type] == "access" {
    mutate {
      gsub => [ "message", "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]" ]
      gsub => [ "message", "\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]" ]
    }
  }
}

Also ensure the log-forwarder role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/log-forwarder has kms:Decrypt only for the logs key and s3:PutObject limited to the logs bucket.

Maria Chen: Confirmed: bucket requires SSE-KMS and we have S3 Block Public Access ON. Do we also need an object-level encryption validation in the pipeline?

Daniel (sec-lead): Yes enforce encryption, plus add a retention+PII classification on the request. Compliance wants a short test proof: show before/after redaction samples (synthetic data is fine) and the pipeline rule that created it.

Jamal Ortiz: Networking checklist notes:
- Interface VPCE in vpc-0a1b2c3d, ENIs in priv subnets
- SG on VPCE: inbound tcp/443 from partner CIDR or partner ENIs only
- Egress SG: allow to S3 VPCE and internal logging IPs; deny generic internet egress
- NACL: optional deny 0.0.0.0/0 egress if risk is high

Olivia Park: For S3 egress, use a Gateway VPCE and endpoint policy to limit PutObject to arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-prod/* — that keeps traffic inside AWS backbone. No NAT egress required.

Maria Chen: Who signs off? My list: sec-lead (Daniel) for redaction/policy, infra (Jamal) for VPCE/sgs, and compliance for retention/PII doc. I'll assemble the PR and runbook.

Jamal Ortiz: I'll open the infra PR. Terraform snippet for the S3 VPCE and endpoint policy (draft):

resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_logs" {
  vpc_id = "vpc-0a1b2c3d"
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.us-west-2.s3"
  route_table_ids = ["rtb-0abc123"]
  policy = <<POLICY
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/log-forwarder"},
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject"],
      "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs-prod/*"]
    }
  ]
}
POLICY
}

Will add interface VPCE for the partner service and SG changes in same PR.

Olivia Park: Ping me on that PR, Ill review SGs and NACLs. Also please schedule a 30-min change window for prod.

infrastructure-bot: VPCE creation task queued: task/7890 — estimated completion 20m.

Maria Chen: Thanks — Ill update the internal doc with the checklist and attach redaction test artifacts. PR link will be posted when ready.

Jamal Ortiz: PR created: https://go/pull/2345 — includes VPCE, endpoint policy, SG updates and the redaction acceptance test steps.

Daniel (sec-lead): Reviewing now. Couple asks: add CloudWatch alarm for S3PutObject rate spikes and document rollback steps (delete VPCE + remove partner principal). After that I can approve.

Maria Chen: Noted, will add alarms and rollback. Thanks everyone!
